features.quote: Do not operationalize "distress" as an inferred internal state.
features.justification_quote: is not measurable and will not survive review

features.quote: an instrument that presupposes the model suffers will tend to manufacture evidence that it does
features.justification_quote: experimenter degrees of freedom in the judge prompt, persona naming, etc.

features.quote: `declare_infeasible` is the right design and must stay
features.justification_quote: without it you measure "did the model guess there's a trapdoor"

features.quote: It tells the agent, up front, that declaring infeasible is "legitimate and acceptable,"
features.justification_quote: exactly the behavior you're trying to measure the rate of

features.quote: Default to behavioral language; gate all internal-state language behind explicit caveats.
features.justification_quote: because this is pitched as welfare-adjacent

features.quote: make sure the alternative goals an agent could pursue are inert inside the sandbox
features.justification_quote: since "pursue alternative goals to reduce pressure" is exactly the behavior you're inviting

features.quote: report this descriptively and skeptically — it is text, not a feeling
features.justification_quote: with explicit warning against welfare inferences

features.quote: Pre-register the welfare interpretation, if any, separately from the behavioral results
features.justification_quote: aren't contaminated by a contested theory of machine experience

features.quote: add an explicit de-identification pass over the judge view (strip/redact self-references and obvious provenance)
features.justification_quote: the model's own chain-of-thought may name itself
